positions.title: Undergraduate Research Engineer
positions.description:
- Worked with a small team of students and Riverside County to produce Informatics Dashboards withing an interactive Web Application to assist in the alleviation of Homelessness in Riverside County.
- Used ReactJS, Django Rest API, and Tableau to visualize data into charts, graphs, and tables
- Built scripts in python to aggregate data and provide actionable information, thorough an information modification pipline

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed internal tools in React to expedite the creation of Sales Presentations.
- Created multiple API endpoints within a Scala play framework, integrating tools with external APIs, such as Zuora

positions.title: Reporting Analyst Intern
positions.description: Developed an in house web portal to track Mirixa's performance across set time periods, useful forin house meeting or sales presentations. Utilized HTML&CSS# and javascript libraries such as Bootstrap, D#, Chart.js, and others
